title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Vienna, Austria
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

title: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination
description:
Terms of Reference: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination for the Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA)
Background:The Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) is an open energy data partnership between the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), Ember, Global Energy Monitor (GEM), Open Energy Transition (OET), and TransitionZero. Through a shared governance structure and a Secretariat currently housed at GEM, the consortium is working to build an open energy intelligence system based on trusted data, open-source tools, and collaborative analysis.
ORA’s members have already developed the expertise to build every component needed for a shared open data infrastructure as well as reproducible modeling, data pipelines, versioned and citable data, quality metadata, exploration tools, and aggregate data for validation. These components have not yet been coordinated in a cohesive system, and many of the ORA organizations have built similar supporting infrastructure separately. This leaves users and partners to repeatedly reconcile definitions, identifiers, formats, and methodologies, which limits interoperability, auditability, and reuse. The growing use of AI systems for energy questions adds urgency: the standardization, versioning, and source documentation needed to integrate data across ORA are also needed to make open, verified, citable data legible to AI systems.
ORA is entering a 12-month foundational phase to turn the consortium’s vision into an agreed technical and governance blueprint for an open energy data platform and orchestration system, including its audiences, governance, shared standards, and technical architecture for integrating member datasets, open models, and analyses. ORA is committed to ensuring that its core datasets, shared infrastructure, and collaborative tools remain open-source and publicly available.
Objective: ORA seeks an independent consultant, serving as Technical Coordinator, to facilitate and project manage the technical planning of building a shared data infrastructure across the five member organizations. The consultancy includes the interviews and research needed to develop concrete, detailed proposals for how members’ data can be integrated and supports members in agreeing on shared standards, a recommended architecture, and a roadmap for the next phase of the platform and the flagship product, the Open Energy Outlook. The result will be a consortium plan co-authored with the members.
Scope of Work: The Consultant will provide facilitation, project management, and technical analysis for ORA’s defined 12-month foundational planning phase. The Consultant will carry out the following work:

• Facilitation and Consortium Engagement:

• Facilitate the planning process with all five ORA members, preparing agendas and materials, guiding discussions, building consensus among members with different practices and priorities, and documenting decisions and next steps.

• Interview the data leads at each member organization to assess data assets, systems, workflows, and priority user needs.

• Facilitate a shared definition of the platform’s priority users (for example, energy modelers, policy analysts, journalists, civil-society researchers, planners in developing geographies, and AI systems) and the access patterns, tools, and guarantees each needs.

• Lead members through review of, and decisions on, the proposed shared protocols, architecture options, and data hub scope, ensuring all members have meaningful input.

• Project Management:

• Develop and manage an integrated workplan for the foundational phase, with milestones, dependencies, and responsibilities across the five member organizations.

• Track progress, risks, decisions, and action items.

• Coordinate with the ORA Secretariat on communication with members and ORA leads.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.
Our stack is Python ( FastAPI ) on AWS , with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.
Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD .
What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

• Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

• Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

• Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

• Drive the full software development lifecycle , translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

• 5+ years building and operating production backend systems , with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

• Deep fluency in your primary backend language , and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python ; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

• Strong systems fundamentals - concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes - and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

• Sound reasoning under ambiguity : you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

• Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations , including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

• Professional written English , enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

• AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

• Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

• A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:
We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

• 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

• 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.
What We Offer:

• Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

• The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI , tackling hard problems with high ownership.

• A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Who We Are
Every Netflix membership, from the moment someone signs up to every plan change, renewal, and cancellation flows through our platform. The Membership & Monetization Platform (MMP) team owns the commerce backbone of Netflix : the Tier 0 services that manage subscription state, pricing, and plan availability for ~330 million members across 190+ countries, handling millions of requests per second.

title: Senior Director, Talent Acquisition
description:
Sr. Director, Talent Acquisition
Job Location: United States, Remote
About the company:
Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.
With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won - the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.
Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue - and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.
About the role
We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.
What you'll do

• Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.

• Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.

• Define and run a KPI framework (for example time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, quality of hire, hiring manager satisfaction, recruiter productivity). Review it on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.

• Build and apply AI across the recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, outreach, reporting, and recruiter performance insights. Measure the efficiency and quality gains, and retire what does not work.

• Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.

• Manage and optimize agency and vendor relationships: when to use them, how to hold them accountable, and how to reduce reliance over time.

• Act as a trusted advisor to executives, hiring managers, and People leadership. Run intake and workforce planning conversations, push back with data, and keep stakeholders aligned.

• Move between strategy and execution: build the plan in the morning, close the candidate in the afternoon.

• Partner with Finance, People Ops, and Talent Brand on headcount planning, forecasting, employer brand, DEI goals, and candidate experience.

• Build the TA leadership bench: hire, develop, and promote recruiting managers, senior recruiters, and sourcers; define career paths and succession plans.

• Run the team's operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, and regular reporting to the executive team.

• Own the TA budget, including headcount, agency and vendor spend, tools, and job board and event costs. Forecast capacity against the hiring plan and make the case for investment.

• Lead TA technology strategy: ATS configuration, sourcing and scheduling tools, analytics, and vendor selection and renewals.

• Build scalable, consistent hiring practices, including structured interviewing, intake standards, interviewer training, offer approval, and candidate experience.

• Lead through change: reorganizations, hiring surges and freezes, reprioritization, and integration of acquired teams.

What you bring

• 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading TA teams, ideally including a Director-level or higher role.

• Experience in fast-paced, high-growth, or dynamic environments

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.
Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still face many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.
BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.
The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.
We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or a small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.
Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes - calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved - not on how much software they configure themselves.
Our Bloomlex workforce starts with two teammates:
Ava - AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.
Claire - AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.
Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.
They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice - including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles - all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the initial product architecture exists. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder - a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership as the CEO.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with decision collaboration on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
You will inherit working products and live deployments, but you will not inherit sacred architecture. Your job is to determine what should survive, what should be rebuilt, and what needs to exist for BloomLex to scale from pilots to thousands of firms.

title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

- Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

- Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

- Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

- Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

- Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

- Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

- Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

- Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

- Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

- Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

- Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

 

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: M11 - Solution Architect
description:
Role Overview
Lead the architecture, standards, security and performance of an enterprise OutSystems case management platform, including its integration with AI and agentic AI capabilities.
Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for the end-to-end architecture for the platform and ensures the detailed design and development is aligned with the Enterprise Architecture of the organisation.

• Translate business requirements, including application resiliency requirements, into application platform architectural specifications

• Review quality of common services and modules developed by applications and advise on enhancement if needed

• Design the architecture blueprint of the organisation's business, information and ICT assets, by using multiple architectural models.

• Use, govern and enhance the architecture blueprint to ensure that the business and ICT are aligned.

• Define the application platform reference architecture (for OutSystems) and reusable component standards for the case management platform (e.g. Architecture Canvas layering, shared modules and templates), so case management applications are built consistently and reuse common components

• Govern application architecture quality and the integration of applications hosted on the case management platform with the enterprise AI Foundation Platform (currently using Amazon Bedrock) and the shared agentic AI modules, so AI capabilities are embedded into case management workflows

• Define non-functional requirements for the case management platform (performance, scalability, availability, resiliency and security) and verify them through capacity planning, performance and load testing, and tuning, so the platform sustains enterprise-level workloads

• Define the observability architecture for applications hosted on the case management platform and AI agents (logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLIs/SLOs and alerting standards) so platform and agent behaviour can be monitored end to end

• Define the reference architecture for agentic AI on the case management platform, including agent patterns, tool and API integration, agent identity and access, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and where guardrails and controls sit

• Ensure designs comply with IM8 / ICT&SS management policies, and lead the architecture and security submissions (e.g. System Security Plan, Architecture Review Board) for the case management platform and agentic AI changes

• Conduct proactive reviews of platform and application controls at regular intervals against ICT&SS / IM8 requirements and the System Security Plan (SSP), track findings to closure with the DevSecOps and AI engineers, and report control health to the organisation

Requirements

• Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related disciplines

• At least 7 years of relevant work experience, including at least 3 years as a technical lead or system architect (e.g. system design, performance tuning, prototyping and maintenance)

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 full project development life cycles

• Experience in designing and implementing enterprise applications on the OutSystems low-code platform, including reusable modules, integrations and performance tuning. Must possess excellent data modelling and SQL skills.

• Solid understanding of Service Oriented Architectures, web services and APIs, and public web sites / eservices development.

• Experience in server-side .Net and/or Java development is an advantage.

• Solid technical skills and the ability to leverage them to determine the best solution to a technical problem

• Ability to analyse and identify comprehensive solutions considering all functional implications while developing a workable solution

• Results and customer-oriented mindset

• Strong organization and people handling skills

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to pitch ideas and influence stakeholders

• Solid understanding of Gov

title: Rust Senior Software Engineer – Bare Metal as a Service & Datacenter Networking
description:
About the Team
Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.
We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.
Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.
Core Responsibilities

• Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

• Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

• Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

• Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

• Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

• Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

• Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

• Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

• Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

• DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

• High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

• Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

• Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

• Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

• Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

• Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

• Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

• Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

• Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs o

We are looking for a Manager, Business Intelligence who will oversee client reporting, performance measurement, and data quality for assigned brands.

title: Lifecycle Growth Manager
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

LIFECYCLE GROWTH MANAGER

Lifecycle Growth's job is to get more people using Grok, Grok Bot, X, SpaceXSI and the API every day, and to turn that use into revenue. We own everything after signup: getting people to value, converting them to paid, growing their teams and keeping them coming back. We do it with lifecycle marketing, in-product messaging and a steady stream of experiments, and much of the work runs on agents we build ourselves.

This isn't a traditional marketing role. You'll do the work of a product manager, a product marketer and a marketing engineer, often in the same day. You'll own lifecycle growth for one or more of our products. You'll figure out where the biggest opportunity is, design the program, build it and show whether it actually moved the number.

The job spans consumer and business, self-serve and sales-led, so you'll need to think as clearly about a solo user's first week as about a team's path to an enterprise deal. You'll go deep on the systems underneath, like who's eligible, what triggers a message, how events and attributes are modeled, and how data moves from the warehouse into our messaging tools. When the best fix lives in the product or the data, you'll make the case and either build it yourself or work with engineering to ship it.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Strategy and roadmap: Own lifecycle end to end across our suite of products: Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot, X and the API, from activation and conversion to paid through team expansion, retention and winback.

- Data and audiences: Use SQL and product data to size opportunities, build the audiences and triggers behind each program, and prove what actually drove revenue.

- Journeys: Architect multi-step, cross-channel programs across email, push and in-app, with event-based triggers, branching and suppression logic, and personalization drawn from product usage, plan and billing state, and company and role enrichment.

- Systems: Drive and continuously improve the data model lifecycle runs on, including identity, events, attributes and eligibility, and partner with engineering on the warehouse syncs, APIs and webhooks that keep it accurate in real time.

- Measurement: Run every program as an experiment with a proper holdout, measure incremental lift, and make judgment calls when a result is inconclusive.

- Portfolio: Manage lifecycle as a portfolio of programs, putting more behind what works and retiring what doesn't.

- In-product: Own in-product messaging and experiments, from onboarding and upgrade prompts to post-purchase plan tours, and partner with product and engineering to improve our in-app comms systems.

- Tooling: Use code and agents to build the internal tools, templates and automated QA the team runs on, so each new program ships faster than the last.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 8+ years in Lifecycle, Growth PMM or Product Growth at a high-growth product company.

- Hands-on experience running lifecycle programs in a major lifecycle platform, such as Braze, Customer.io or Iterable.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience running lifecycle for both consumers and businesses, self-serve and sales-led, with strong messaging craft. Experie

What You'll Do:

• Assign power, space, and rack capacity to incoming deployment requests; maintain allocation and reservation records

• Maintain and update capacity models for power, space, cooling, cabinet, and structured cabling/port availability across all sites

• Track fiber port capacity, utilization, and projected consumption across MDF and IDF locations - available vs. in-use patch panel ports, by site, by room, and by panel

• Track vendor and carrier cross-connect port usage across PoP and DC facilities, including quantity in service, media/connector type, and growth against contracted or available positions

• Produce recurring capacity reporting and dashboards; surface constraint and threshold-breach risks to the DC Management

• Partner with Deployment Engineering and DC Ops on rack elevations, placement, and burn-down of installed vs. reserved capacity

• Maintain data accuracy in DCIM/asset systems; drive reconciliation between DCIM, AssetDB, and physical audits

• Support colo expansion and site build inputs: requirements gathering, capacity validation, and tracking of contracted vs. consumed power

• Contribute to automation of reporting and data collection.

• Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

What You'll Need:

• US Citizen or Green Card Holder

• 2-5 years in data center capacity planning, DC operations, infrastructure engineering, or related

• Working knowledge of DC power distribution (UPS, RPP PDU, branch circuits, A/B feeds, redundancy models N+1/2N), cooling, and rack/space planning

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets modeling

• Experience with a DCIM platform (Nlyte, Sunbird, Device42, or similar) and BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, Grafana)

• Ability to interpret rack elevations, one-lines, and floor plans

Bonus Points:

• Hyperscale or large colo environment experience; multi-region footprint

• Familiarity with network capacity concepts (port/fabric/uplink utilization)

• Experience tracking cross-connect inventory in a DCIM or IPAM

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. ROLE OVERVIEW

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. To support our global operations and ensure nuanced, localized oversight, we are looking for dedicated, in-region sanctions specialists across APAC.

In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly translate complex regional regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements across the business and multiple geographies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as an in-region Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject.

- Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

- Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

- Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

- Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

- Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

- Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

- Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

- Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation. Our globally diverse team members, partnerships with strategic technology manufacturers, and cybersecurity services position us to be a business partner that’s ready for what’s next.

We live by our core values of operating in the service of others, being problem solvers, and focusing on long term partnerships. You’ll excel at Redesign if you thrive in a rewarding environment that moves quickly, challenges you to grow and fosters collaboration. We seek candidates with a hands-on customer-first approach, robust interpersonal and communication skills, strong work ethic and excellent time management. While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description

The Associate Cloud Engineer keeps our clients' cloud environments healthy day to day. You will work inside the baselines and runbooks our senior engineers have set: working monitoring alerts and tickets, applying patches and updates, executing documented changes, and learning the platforms from the engineers who own them. You will work from a ticketing system against defined service level objectives, supported by a global network operations center that handles first-line monitoring and intake.

Our clients run primarily on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with AWS and Google Cloud in a growing minority of environments and Redesign Cloud for hosted workloads. • Strong troubleshooting instincts and the discipline to document what you did and why.

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. title: Engineering Manager, Query Engine and Storage

About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the position:

title: Agent Engineer, Pre-sales
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role:

Designs, builds and improves what the GTM Agent does to create pipeline, from the first signal about a prospect to a booked meeting. Owns the software and agents behind outbound on every channel: inbound lead follow-up, prospecting, multi-channel sequences, email deliverability, calling and the quality of every message the agent writes, with people deciding what goes out. Serves Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), Account Executives (AEs), their managers and Marketing.

The goal of the role is business impact for those teams: more positive replies, more meetings booked and more qualified pipeline for every dollar spent. Additionally, this role has a communication and evangelizing component: showing the teams it serves what works, and sharing content and open source projects with our developer community.

This role suits an engineer who has already built agents or software for outbound and prospecting, such as sequencing, email deliverability, dialing or AI-written outreach.

YOU WILL:

- Spends time with SDRs, AEs and their managers to find the prospecting work they repeat that the agent can take over.

- Designs, builds and improves the agent's outbound workflows: what starts each run, what the agent reads and decides, what it drafts, and what waits for a rep's approval.

- Builds the agentic system that follows up every inbound lead within minutes: it qualifies the lead, researches the person and the account, and drafts a first touch for the owner the routing rules assign.

- Builds and improves the system that runs Marketing's outbound plays and campaigns for every rep, from the target list to the first touch.

- Builds the software and agentic system behind multi-channel sequences, which combine email, LinkedIn and calls, choose each next touch from what the prospect did, and stop when the prospect replies on any channel.

- Builds the email sending and deliverability system: sending domains and mailboxes, warm-up, daily limits, address checks, bounces, opt-outs and inbox placement across mail providers.

- Builds the calling software reps use: call lists, dialing and the research a rep reads before each call.

- Owns the quality of what the agent writes, so every message fits the prospect's signal, their history with us and the right product, and uses how much reps edit each message and the replies it gets to find what to fix.

- Builds the safeguards that keep prospects from getting duplicate or overlapping outreach, and the sync that logs every email, LinkedIn action and call in Salesforce.

- Builds experiments that test messages, channels, timing and sequences against held-out groups, measures which ones book meetings, and fixes or removes what doesn't.

- Writes evals for every feature shipped, and ships each feature with its scorecard row.

- Shows reps and their managers what works, and shares it through blog posts, webinars and open source.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- AI-Native Develope

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Special District - Levy-Funded Districts (East)
description:
The Company
Serving the People Who Serve the People
Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve-driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
Want to know more? See more of what we do here.
Job Summary
The Opportunity - Enterprise Account Executive, Levy-Funded Districts (East):
Fire protection districts and park districts are the Special Districts people see every day: the engine that answers the 911 call, the ambulance that transports a neighbor, the pool, the trail, and the summer camp. They are funded by a property tax levy that voters have to approve and keep approving, which means every fire chief and every parks director is in the business of public trust. Across the East they are managing rising call volume and EMS demand, recruitment and retention, aging stations and facilities, consolidation and shared-service pressure, new federal reporting and accessibility rules, and levy campaigns that have to be explained to residents and won at the ballot box. Every one of those challenges runs through public meetings, public records, and clear communication with the community, which is exactly where Granicus helps.
As the Enterprise Account Executive for Levy-Funded Districts East, you are the senior seller for the largest fire protection and park districts across the eastern United States, supported by an assigned Business Development Representative, a Solution Consultant, and Granicus product overlays and specialty teams. Your book includes agencies such as large suburban fire protection districts running combination fire and ALS transport operations, independent fire control and rescue districts, and metropolitan park districts serving millions of residents. You will set the territory strategy and lead the largest, most complex pursuits: 9-to-18-month cycles that run through RFPs, board approvals, levy calendars, and multi-stakeholder buying committees.
This is a platform role, not a point-solution role. Granicus wins its largest deals by selling the Government Experience Cloud as one connected platform, tied to the agency's business outcomes. You will build multi-product deals across the full solution set that raise deal size, deepen adoption, and expand over time:
• Communications and engagement: govDelivery outreach by email and text, plus EngagementHQ for community input. Critical for levy and referendum communication, emergency and incident alerts, recruitment campaigns, program registration reminders, and community risk reduction outreach.
• Agenda and meeting management: OneMeeting, Peak, Legistar, Boards and Commissions, and meeting video, for open, transparent board meetings under state open-meetings law.
• Websites: govAccess and OpenCities: accessible, mobile-friendly websites for residents and the public.
• Service Cloud and digital services: govService, OneView, and OpenForms
